lead.titleZh: 肺癌术后肺康复：系统综述聚焦时机与设置对功能恢复的影响
lead.titleEn: Pulmonary Rehab Post-Lung Cancer Surgery: Timing & Setting Impact on Function (Systematic Review)
lead.paragraphZh: 今日关注 3 个条目，覆盖 3 个专业方向。其中 1 篇系统综述对肺癌术后肺康复的时机与设置如何影响功能恢复进行了量化分析，这是今天最值得临床 PT 花时间审阅的信号。另有 2 篇得分 65，其中 1 篇为述评。
lead.paragraphEn: Today's feed includes 3 items across 3 specialties. A systematic review examining the effect of pulmonary rehabilitation timing and setting on functional recovery post-lung cancer surgery is the most impactful signal for clinical PTs. There are also 2 other items with a score of 65, one of which is a commentary.

items.title: General Archives - BJSM blog - social media's leading SEM voice
items.summary: The BJSM blog provides recent insights into sports medicine, including articles on hamstring strain injuries, traditional Chinese exercises for musculoskeletal disorders, Achilles tendon rupture management, concussion exams, exercise for heart health, and tendinopathy exercise prescription.
items.curatedReason: 这份 BJSM 博文合集确实内容广泛，涵盖从腘绳肌损伤到脑震荡评估等多个热门话题。虽然是博客形式，并非原始研究，但它能让你快速掌握当前运动医学的讨论热点，并可能引导你找到更深入的近期 BJSM 论文。
items.titleZh: BJSM 博客一般文章存档
items.summaryZh: BJSM 博客提供了运动医学的最新见解，包括关于腘绳肌拉伤、用于肌肉骨骼疾病的传统中医练习、跟腱断裂管理、脑震荡检查、心脏健康锻炼和肌腱病运动处方等文章。
items.curatedReasonEn: This BJSM blog collection offers a broad, relevant overview of current hot topics in sports medicine, from hamstring injuries to concussion assessment. While not original research, it's a good starting point for quickly grasping current discussions and might direct you to recent, more in-depth BJSM papers.

items.title: Response to letter to the editor regarding 'barriers and facilitators of decision-making in home-based rehabilitation exercise among older adults following total knee arthroplasty: A qualitative study'.
items.summary: This article is a response to a letter to the editor regarding a qualitative study on barriers and facilitators of decision-making in home-based rehabilitation exercise among older adults following total knee arthroplasty. It does not present new data or findings.

items.title: Effect of the timing and setting of pulmonary rehabilitation on functional recovery after lung cancer surgery: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials (1137 patients) found late-phase pulmonary rehabilitation significantly improved 6-min walk distance (MD = 68.86 m, 95% CI 53.46-84.26) and VO2peak (MD = 2.62 ml/kg/min, 95% CI 2.08-3.15) after lung cancer surgery. Early in-hospital rehabilitation showed no significant short-term benefits. Fully and partially supervised modes did not differ significantly in 6MWD.
items.curatedReason: 肺癌术后，晚期肺康复是关键，能显著提高患者的 6 分钟步行距离（增加 68.86 米）和 VO2peak。别指望早期住院康复有短期奇效，而且部分监督和全程监督模式对 6MWD 效果相当，你有更多选择空间。
items.titleZh: 肺癌术后肺康复时机与设置对功能恢复的影响：一项系统综述和荟萃分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项包含随机对照试验（1137 例患者）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，肺癌术后晚期肺康复显著改善了 6 分钟步行距离（均差 = 68.86 m, 95% CI 53.46-84.26）和峰值摄氧量（均差 = 2.62 ml/kg/min, 95% CI 2.08-3.15）。早期住院康复未显示显著的短期益处。完全监督和部分监督模式在 6 分钟步行距离上无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: After lung cancer surgery, late-phase pulmonary rehabilitation is crucial, significantly improving patients' 6-minute walk distance (by 68.86 m) and VO2peak. Don't expect early in-hospital rehabilitation to show significant short-term benefits, and partially supervised modes are comparable to fully supervised ones for 6MWD, giving you more flexibility.
items.limitation: 不同研究间存在一定异质性，对结果的解释需考虑具体康复方案和患者人群差异。
items.limitationEn: Some heterogeneity exists between studies, so results must be interpreted considering specific rehabilitation protocols and patient population differences.
